purpose: Bring historical/current Arkansas budgets into analytical use for the Money Engine — without analyzing every appropriation.

headline_now.label: GENERAL REVENUE DISTRIBUTED TO AGENCIES AND INSTITUTIONS (Allocation A)

how_arkansas_is_funded_today.summary: Operating government at state level is still an appropriation machine funded by General Revenue and other streams (federal, special, dedicated). This bridge uses GR Allocation A as the visible NOW spine — not the entire state financial universe.
major_revenue_dependencies: General Revenue taxes and related state collections feeding RSA allocations
Federal funds (not fully normalized in this seed — Stage 2.5 deepen)
Dedicated/special revenues often already pledged (cannot be double-counted as replacement)

where_major_expenditures_flow.character: Recurring human-capacity / medical transfer system — essential continuity under Dependency Rule
where_major_expenditures_flow.cc_implication: Replace funding sources carefully; do not abolish service capacity while engines grow

where_major_expenditures_flow.label: Institutions of Higher Education (total)
where_major_expenditures_flow.character: Capability / human-capital asset building — mixed with operating consumption
where_major_expenditures_flow.cc_implication: Align with HC-01 education prosperity; treat as capability investment where outcomes clear

where_major_expenditures_flow.label: Department of Corrections (total package in seed)

where_major_expenditures_flow.label: DESE — Education Freedom Accounts

Policy-created expenditure shift inside education — track for capability outcomes later

Human services that preserve household capacity to work and thrive (continuity)
toward_recurring_consumption_or_containm: Large medical/transfer operations without upstream prevention
Any dedicated fee already spent that cannot fund tax retirement
capability_assets_vs_recurring_consumpti.rule: Money Engine success is not 'spend more' — it is fund public goods from retained prosperity while households gain
